verdict.rationale: Morph is API-first. Its docs describe an OpenAI-compatible base URL (`https://api.morphllm.com/v1`) with one key covering the chat models and its specialized tools, plus a native Anthropic Messages endpoint, batch, custom Reflex training jobs and dedicated endpoints, with an LLM-readable llms.txt index. Independent hands-on use confirms it: a developer wired the OpenAI-compatible endpoint into their own CLI tool, and the goose author reports using it in production combos. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404).
